title: Building
description: A building blueprint defined as a 2D array of tile ids

tiles.description: 2D array of tile ids forming the building blueprint

name.description: Display name for this building (optional, used by test rendering)

type.description: Type of building (optional, used by test rendering)

width.description: Width of the building blueprint (optional, used by test rendering)

height.description: Height of the building blueprint (optional, used by test rendering)

overrides.description: If present, this building overrides another building with the same id
